report.success_criterion: On buggy commit b9cc4a636d00 the test `test_add_dt64_non_nano_with_offset_parameter` FAILS because `tm.assert_index_equal(result, expected)` detects incorrect values due to truncation/rounding to the original non-nano unit (dtype `datetime64[s]` or `datetime64[ms]`) instead of preserving sub-unit precision from `offset.offset`. On the fixed revision (PR #64809), the same assertion PASSES because `_add_offset` selects a finer `res_unit`/dtype (datetime64[us]) when the offset has a non-zero sub-unit parameter.
